column1: # The per-repository block of every copy of the jira-conventions skill.
# The skill's shared body lives in rtldev-middleware-template; scripts/jira-skill-policy.sh
# renders each repository's copy as that body plus the row below, and the weekly
# jira-skill-policy-drift.yml job fails on any copy that differs. Every repository
# .gitmodules registers, and this workspace itself, needs a row — a repository without one
# is drift, so a newly registered repository cannot silently go without the skill.
# <note> is "-" for none, otherwise one extra bullet in the rendered block.
# <title prefix> "@skip" leaves a repository out on purpose; <note> then says why.
# The template's own row holds the template's {{TOKENS}}, so a repository created from it
# starts with placeholders to fill in, the same as its CLAUDE.md.
# Component ids are the RSRMID project's component list. A new -sdk repository takes its
# name uppercased as the prefix, and SDKs (10230) when Jira has no component for it yet.
